stimulus.body: L'extrait ci-dessous sert à vérifier la compréhension de cette forme. «Signal coverage and terrain.» « s survey asks what mainly constrains a remote call » Parmi les quatre réponses, une seule s'appuie sur le texte lui-même.

questions.stem: La consigne de cet item est «Remember call constraints / Signal and terrain. / The constraint behind a broken-up call». Quelle réponse en découle ?

options.misconception: mistakes a surface feature of "The caller's hat" for the governing rule
reverses the direction of the reasoning the passage sets out
treats "The time of lunch" as if it followed from the evidence

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: signal coverage and terrain constrain quality; hat, brand, or lunch time do not. On that basis "Signal coverage and terrain" is the supported choice. Option C ("The phone's brand") fails because it reverses the direction of the reasoning that settles the constraint behind a broken-up call; Option B ("The caller's hat") fails because it mistakes a surface feature of "The caller's hat" for the governing rule; Option D ("The time of lunch") fails because it treats "The time of lunch" as if it followed from the evidence.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: What a ranking actually optimises for

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: «It makes popular items seem most important.» Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: En appliquant «Analyze ranking optimisation / Salience signals importance. / What a ranking actually optimises for» au fragment, quelle option se justifie ?

options.text: It makes popular items seem most important

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: engagement foregrounding signals importance; it does not change data, authorship, or accuracy. On that basis "It makes popular items seem most important" is the supported choice. Option A ("It fixes all factual errors") fails because it confuses ranking with accuracy; Option D ("It changes the data collected") fails because it confuses ranking with collection; Option C ("It alters the author's name") fails because it confuses ranking with authorship.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: The signal a recommendation feed rewards

stimulus.body: L'extrait ci-dessous sert à vérifier la compréhension de cette forme. «Judge by whether it surfaces diverse, relevant content or merely repeats high-engagement items; the latter signals engagement over discovery.» Parmi les quatre réponses, une seule s'appuie sur le texte lui-même.

questions.stem: La consigne de cet item est «Evaluate a feed's reward signal / Diversity vs repetition. / The signal a recommendation feed rewards». Quelle réponse en découle ?

answer.exemplar: Judge by whether it surfaces diverse, relevant content or merely repeats high-engagement items; the latter signals engagement over discovery.

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: discovery serves diverse relevant content; engagement repeats high-engagement items. On that basis "Judge by whether it surfaces diverse, relevant content or merely repeats high-engagement…" is the supported choice.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: How a filter bubble forms

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: «Discovery of new species declines.» Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: En appliquant «Analyze filter bubble effects / What gets lost? / How a filter bubble forms» au fragment, quelle option se justifie ?
questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: filtering reduces discovery of new species; it does not change speed, font, or reality. On that basis "Discovery of new species declines" is the supported choice. Option A ("The app becomes faster") fails because it confuses filtering with speed; Option B ("The font shrinks") fails because it confuses text with typography; Option D ("The species go extinct") fails because it confuses app with reality.

questions.topic: What a hashtag does

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: «Specific species and region tags.» Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: Avec «Create a hashtag strategy / Specific and relevant. / What a hashtag does» en téte, quelle option est conforme au texte ?

options.misconception: mistakes a surface feature of "Vague generic tags" for the governing rule

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: specific, relevant tags aid discovery; vague, absent, or unrelated tags do not. On that basis "Specific species and region tags" is the supported choice. Option A ("No tags at all") fails because it no discovery aid; Option B ("Vague generic tags") fails because it mistakes a surface feature of "Vague generic tags" for the governing rule; Option C ("Random unrelated tags") fails because it misleading discovery.
